_comment: Hand-written facts Blender cannot dump in -b (ARCHITECTURE §4.1, spec/overlay in M1). Source: io_scene_gltf2 5.2.41 __init__.py get_format_items (GLTF_EMBEDDED only with the allow_embedded_format add-on preference, off in factory settings).

items.name: glTF Binary (.glb)
items.description: Exports a single file, with all data packed in binary form. Most efficient and portable, but more difficult to edit later

items.name: glTF Separate (.gltf + .bin + textures)
items.description: Exports multiple files, with separate JSON, binary and texture data. Easiest to edit later
